records.text: In 2013, Erika Kirk was 25, was dating Josh Harrellson, and moved to Michigan to be with him.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1hcjQGgvxUY)

appearances.snippet: Erica (Erika Kirk) was 25 years old and she was in a relationship with a basketball player named Joshua Harrelson. ... So at the time he was living in Michigan and Erica (Erika Kirk) moved out there to be with him.

verification.notes: Public material supports a 2013 Michigan connection and Erika Frantzve's birth date, but not the full compound claim. Erika was born November 20, 1988, so she was 24—not 25—at the September 2013 meeting discussed in context; available public posts do not independently establish that she moved to Michigan specifically for Josh Harrellson.

sources.title: Erika Kirk
sources.relevance: Gives the November 20, 1988 birth date, showing she was 24 in September 2013.

sources.title: The Texts Erika Kirk Doesn't Want You To See

records.text: On September 15, 2013, Josh Harrellson and Erika Kirk met 15-year-old Jillian Falcon.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1hcjQGgvxUY)

appearances.snippet: On the evening of September 15th, 2013, ... Joshua Harrelson and Erica (Erika Kirk) met a 15-year-old girl named Jillian Falcon.

verification.notes: Archived links to Jillian Falcon's original public posts support that she had met Erika by September 17, 2013 and continued corresponding with her. They do not independently establish the exact September 15 meeting date or every age/detail in the statement.
